MIN 743 (M+F) Changes to NAVTEX and Maritime Safety Information (MSI) arrangements in the English Channel from 1 January 2027
This Marine Information Note provides information on changes to the provision of Maritime Safety Information (MSI) in the English Channel from 1 January 2027, following changes to the existing arrangements between the United Kingdom (UK) and France.
Documents
Details
Notice to all Shipowners, Masters, Superintendents and Skippers of Fishing Vessels, Yachts and Other Seagoing Craft.
This notice should be read with MGN 375 (M+F) Maritime safety information Amendment 1 - GOV.UK and the Maritime Safety Information (MSI) Leaflet – Advice Note 1033
This MIN expires July 2027.
